high_level_description:
Create a portrait digital vector graphic infographic with a horizontal bar chart as its main quantitative subject.

Anchor <chart 6> at the center of the canvas as a large data region. Inside it, the quantitative marks, labels, and structural guides remain visually coordinated.

Use <text 2> and <text 3> as the editorial entry point in the upper left, with a clear hierarchy of scale, weight, and spacing. Supporting regions include <image 4> at the upper right, <text 263> at the lower center, and <shape 5> at the upper band.

Finish the graphic with clean, modern editorial style with a focus on data clarity over a flat full-canvas field. Use even graphic lighting with subtle shadow effects for local depth and clear layer separation.

style_description.aesthetics: Clean, modern editorial style with a focus on data clarity. Uses a light neutral background with subtle grid lines or spacing to separate the dense rows of the chart. The color palette is derived from the chart's existing vibrant sport-specific colors, balanced against a neutral typographic hierarchy. Modern data journalism / infographic style.
style_description.lighting: Flat, even lighting typical of digital editorial graphics. or gradients on the background; emphasis is achieved through color contrast and typography.
style_description.medium: Digital vector illustration, clean lines, flat colors.
